items.title: A Data-First Approach to Mainframe Modernization with AWS Transform and Qlik
items.summary: AI agents are making mainframe modernization programmable. This post walks through a data-first migration pattern that pairs Qlik Replicate's log-based Change Data Capture (CDC) with the agentic AI of AWS Transform and Kiro. Using the strangler fig pattern and blue/green deployment, it migrates wave by wave, keeping the mainframe as system of record until each module is validated and the mainframe is finally decommissioned. Rising hardware costs, a shrinking COBOL and PL/I talent pool, batch-processing limits, and constrained innovation are driving organizations to make the move.
items.creator: Sathisan Vannadil
